description: Customising a car in the shops (commerce): paints, performance parts, skill mods, plates and vinyls, paid for or taken from the inventory, and what happens when the basket is short of funds or invalid.

steps.note: Registration logs in too: launcher token ...0001.
Permanent session ...0002.
Driver 100: level 60, 350000 cash, the starting powerups and insurance.
Selecting it.
A starter car (75000): car 1, with six gloss paints and one vinyl.
Its parts.
Repainting all six slots in another gloss colour: six paints of group GLOSS removed and six added, at 500 each.
An engine (16000): the rating and class change.
A better engine (32000), the old one selling back for 4000.
A skill mod (13000).
A license plate (5000).
A vinyl that costs 1500 boost, which the driver doesn't have. Static data: restored in the last step.
sql: UPDATE vinylproduct SET price = 1500, currency = '_NS' WHERE hash = 361907633

steps.note: Swapping the vinyl for it: insufficient funds, and the car as it was.
Boost.
sql: UPDATE persona SET boost = 5000 WHERE ID = 100

steps.note: Now it's bought; a scale of 3277 is stored as 0, and a removed vinyl sells for nothing.
An engine in the inventory.
sql: INSERT INTO inventory_item (expirationDate, remainingUseCount, resellPrice, status, inventoryEntity_id, productId) VALUES (NULL, 1, 6000, 'ACTIVE', (SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE personaId = 100), 'SRV-PERF-37F824AC')

steps.note: Fitting the engine from the inventory: free, the item is used up, and the old engine sells back for 8000.
Another engine in the inventory.
sql: INSERT INTO inventory_item (expirationDate, remainingUseCount, resellPrice, status, inventoryEntity_id, productId) VALUES (NULL, 1, 12000, 'ACTIVE', (SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE personaId = 100), 'SRV-PERF-B0F38419')

steps.note: Fitting a copy of it with the product in the basket: paid for (48000), and the inventory item stays.
Selling that inventory item: its resell price (12000) comes back.
A skill mod in the inventory, and little cash.
sql: INSERT INTO inventory_item (expirationDate, remainingUseCount, resellPrice, status, inventoryEntity_id, productId) VALUES (NULL, 1, 6375, 'ACTIVE', (SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE personaId = 100), 'SRV-SKILL-A3E960F0')
UPDATE persona SET cash = 100 WHERE ID = 100

steps.note: The skill mod from the inventory and a plate (5000) the driver can't pay for: insufficient funds, but the skill mod is used up anyway.
Cash, and two parts in the inventory.
sql: UPDATE persona SET cash = 1000000 WHERE ID = 100

INSERT INTO inventory_item (expirationDate, remainingUseCount, resellPrice, status, inventoryEntity_id, productId) VALUES (NULL, 1, 6680, 'ACTIVE', (SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE personaId = 100), 'SRV-PERF-1D0F6829')

INSERT INTO inventory_item (expirationDate, remainingUseCount, resellPrice, status, inventoryEntity_id, productId) VALUES (NULL, 1, 10000, 'ACTIVE', (SELECT id FROM inventory WHERE personaId = 100), 'SRV-PERF-4AF5C6F')

steps.note: An engine from the inventory and a vinyl that doesn't exist: the invalid vinyl comes first in the multimap's hash order, so the engine isn't used.
The same with the other engine and an invalid vinyl that comes last: the engine is used up before the basket is found invalid.
A performance part that isn't a product: the lookup throws, and everything rolls back.
